fusions.name: Living Spur
fusions.desc: Breaks a spur off your own body and throws it, which deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets and makes it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. It costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Breakwater
fusions.desc: Strikes every enemy within 3 tiles, which deals 12 damage and knocks them back 3 tiles. You restore 6 health.

fusions.name: Accretion
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Reef Causeway
fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. While you are on water or swamp, from bronze rank you move 10% faster, from silver your health regenerates 15% faster, and from gold your armour rises by 6%.
